name: order_overview
description: Look up one of the signed-in customer's orders: status, total, and each line's book_id, title, quantity, and price in cents. Call it first for any question about an order. Read-only.

order_id.description: Harbor order ID, such as ord-5001

name: refund_damaged_copy
description: Refund the price paid for one book that arrived damaged on a delivered order. Needs the damage_case that Harbor's fulfillment agent returns from report-damage, and the customer's approval, which the host asks for. Each book on an order is refunded at most once. Changes data: issues a refund, confirmed later by Harbor.

order_id.description: Harbor order ID, such as ord-5001

book_id.description: Harbor book ID from the order's lines

name: report_damage
description: Record that one book on a delivered order arrived damaged. Send a data part with order_id, book_id, and a short description. Returns a damage_case artifact with case_id, return_required, and refund_eligible. (Asks Harbor Books fulfillment agent over A2A.)
